title: An Embarrassingly Simple Data Selection Strategy for Million-Scale Multi-Modal Instruction-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2503.13383v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent research demonstrates that pretrained large language models (LLMs) require minimal but carefully curated data for instruction-tuning. Building on LLMs, multi-modal models further contend with far larger data volumes, heterogeneous sources, and cross-modal alignment, amplifying both the necessity and the complexity of data selection. However, existing methods rely on deeply extracted embeddings, gradients or narrow quality scores that are time-consuming to compute and limited in expressiveness, frequently failing to surpass a simple random-sampling baseline. To overcome these limitations, we step back from complex embedding spaces and target the fundamental objective of instruction tuning: how and what knowledge should be elicited from the pretrained model and exposed to users. translated_title: 一种极其简单的百万规模多模态指令微调数据选择策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2503.13383v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：近期研究表明，预训练大语言模型（LLMs）在指令微调时仅需少量但经过精心筛选的数据。在大语言模型基础上的多模态模型还要面对更庞大的数据规模、异构的数据来源以及跨模态对齐等问题，这使得数据选择的必要性和复杂性都被进一步放大。然而，现有方法依赖于深度提取的嵌入向量、梯度或范围狭窄的质量评分，这些指标计算耗时且表达能力有限，往往难以超越简单的随机采样基线。为克服这些局限，我们摒弃复杂的嵌入空间，回归指令微调的根本目标：应当从预训练模型中引出什么样的知识，以及如何将这些知识呈现给用户。我们利用交互风格作为结构多样性的代理指标，并将数据质量分解为针对特定能力的维度……
tldr: 该论文提出一种极其简单的百万规模多模态指令微调数据选择策略，以交互风格衡量结构多样性、按能力维度评估数据质量，无需计算复杂的嵌入或梯度即可高效筛选高质量指令数据。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an embarrassingly simple data selection strategy for million-scale multi-modal instruction-tuning, which leverages interaction styles as a proxy for structural diversity and decomposes data quality into capability-specific dimensions, enabling efficient curation of high-quality instruction data without costly embeddings or gradients.
